construction.basis: f_k = sum_j zeta_3^{-jk} e_j,  k = 1..2, on the sum-zero subspace of the coset permutation module, where g e_j' = e_j, j' the coset that contains xi_j g
construction.note: D_kl(g) = (1/n) sum_i zeta_n^{i k - sigma_g(i) l}

construction.basis: the Cartesian frame of CONVENTIONS.md section 3
construction.note: D(g) = P(g) = elements.items[g].matrix, in the row-vector convention of CONVENTIONS.md section 4

norm.rule: the integral of |f_(kappa,m)|^2 over the domain is vol(domain)/(2J+1)

harmonics.rule: f_(kappa,m)(Q) = sum_(m') conj(c_(m')) D^(J,p)(Q)_(m'm), m = J, ..., -J, for the vector c = (c_J, ..., c_-J) of the copy kappa at J of the trivial irrep (p = (-1)^J) or of the determinant character (p = -(-1)^J), the amplitudes of its kets, and D^(J,p) the matrices of O(3) of the relation `euler`; then f_(kappa,m)(g Q) = f_(kappa,m)(Q) for every g of G: a function on the cosets G Q

Sym^v = sum over l of r^(v-l) H_l; H_l = D^(l,(-1)^l) restricted to the image, pulled back by element_map
